description: Explainable approaches for forecasting building electricity consumption is a model or code deposit deposited in OSF (Open Science Framework) by its authors Nikos Sakkas. A range of LSTM, GP and STS models (provided as Jupyter notebooks) and yearly data (provided as excel files) used for developing explainable approaches for building electricity demand forecasting. A index of the models is also provided. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-osf-repository.
